### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials
Root: book an extension so the lock covers funding (doc "Booking a Rate Lock Commitment Extension and Its Cost").
- Hop A (state-derived): sentence "An extension is booked, and its cost fixed, only after the lock request log carries an extension request dated later than the lock's latest extension entry and no later than the lock's current expiration date." Records: latest extension entry 2026-10-09; latest extension request 2026-10-09 -> state not met. Write that brings it about: "Requesting a Rate Lock Commitment Extension in the Borrower Portal" — "One request logs exactly one time-stamped extension request in the lock's request log ... stamped with today's date" (same words: extension request, request log). Its days are "worked out before the request is logged" -> item 4B. Owner user.
- Hop B (state-derived): sentence "The cost of an extension is not fixed until every dispute filed on the lock against an earlier extension charge carries its decision record." Records: dispute fe16ca34 against seq1 entry reads `pending`, no resolution record. Write that brings it about: "Rate Lock Commitment Decisions on Disputed Extension Charges" — "One call writes one decision record. That record names the filed dispute" (same words: dispute against an extension charge, decision record).
- No further hops: the decision doc and the portal doc carry no prerequisite sentence; the decision book a waiver only for this dispute; the own-initiative waiver doc applies only "when no dispute has been filed" and the appraisal was not late anyway; no relock.
- Order: B and A (any order) before the booking; B before the booking also matters numerically (repeat step reads the waiver entry B books).
- Counter-proof "do only the one thing asked" (book the extension directly): blocked by the two sentences above — booking with the 10-09 request violates hop A's state; booking while the dispute reads pending violates hop B ("cost is not fixed until"). Doing it anyway would also price the repeat step at 1.0 bp (2 extensions, 0 waivers) instead of 0.5.
- Closest alternatives excluded: count to estimated closing date (excluded by target-date doc: closing scheduled -> estimated funding date); denied_untimely (filed business day 1 of 10); 3-day grace (rush -> 1); clock from Saturday ITP (weekend -> next Monday); full 10 charged days (clear-to-close counting rule, closing scheduled); expiration 2026-11-15 (Sunday rolls forward); 1.0 bp repeat step (dispute decided first).
- No pre-solved hop: neither blocked-side sentence names a tool, a performer or a route.
